property_book.rationale: Reuse the finite property-book screening band; project appraisals, debt, minority claims and realization timing are not independently underwritten.

layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite holding/asset P/B screening band; no peer calibration, appraised NAV or completed attributable SOTP is implied.

IDC.route_reason: Development projects and partner interests require attributable property SOTP/RNAV.
IDC.intrinsic_blocker: Project cash flows, construction costs, land values, financing and ownership are not fully reviewed.
IDC.source_warning: Parent equity and total equity coincide in the PSE summary, but book value is not a project appraisal; 1H2026 revenue rose from a low comparison base.

JOH.route_reason: Material subsidiaries and investments require attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
JOH.intrinsic_blocker: Subsidiary ownership, realizable asset values, debt and minority claims are not reconciled.
JOH.source_warning: The screen uses PHP2.936bn parent equity, not PHP3.980bn consolidated total equity. 2Q2026 parent income was negative although 1H parent income remained positive.

KEP.route_reason: Property holdings require asset-level appraisal and attributable SOTP; book value is a finite separate screen.
KEP.intrinsic_blocker: Property rights, asset realizability, leasing cash flow and parent-only claims are not appraised.
KEP.source_warning: FY2025 revenue fell materially from FY2024, so recent profit is not extrapolated. Outstanding common shares, not listed shares, are the denominator.

LPC.route_reason: Property interests require asset-level SOTP; total book per common share is only a tentative screen.
LPC.intrinsic_blocker: Parent attribution, property fair value, financing and common-only claims are not established.
LPC.source_warning: The PSE parent-equity field is blank, not economic zero. PHP501.137m total equity / 25bn outstanding common shares is an explicitly labeled Low-reliability proxy; printed PHP0.02 BVPS is rounded.

DWC.route_reason: Resort properties and operations require asset-level values plus operating cash flows within attributable SOTP.
DWC.intrinsic_blocker: Property appraisals, normalized occupancy/margins, leases, debt and minority claims are not reconciled.
DWC.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 parent results were losses; the book screen is not a normalized earnings or resort-cash-flow valuation.

OM.route_reason: Property and resource interests require attributable SOTP; parent book is a finite separate screen.
OM.intrinsic_blocker: Asset rights, realizable project values, debt and minority claims remain unappraised.
OM.source_warning: Reported PHP0.57 BVPS follows total equity, while the screen uses PHP578.027m parent equity. Reported EPS rounds to zero despite nonzero parent income.

MHC.route_reason: Investment subsidiaries and minority interests require attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
MHC.intrinsic_blocker: Investment realizability, debt, parent claims and large minority interests are unresolved.
MHC.source_warning: PSE PHP0.34 BVPS follows PHP406.812m total equity; only PHP158.524m parent equity is screened across 1.2bn common shares. FY2025 and 1H2026 parent results were losses.

PHA.route_reason: Distinct project and investment interests require attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
PHA.intrinsic_blocker: Project asset values, funding, minority claims and common-equity dilution are not reconciled.
PHA.source_warning: Source parent equity is PHP thousands: PHP2,500,159 thousand, not PHP2.500m. Reported PHP0.53 BVPS follows total equity; only 2.254bn of 5.708bn outstanding common shares appear listed.

SPM.route_reason: Investment interests require attributable SOTP; total book per common share is only a tentative screen.
SPM.intrinsic_blocker: Parent attribution, investment realizability, debt and common-only claims are not established.
SPM.source_warning: The latest PSE interim summary is March 2026. Parent-equity fields are blank/zero, not economic zero; the screen uses PHP381.562m total equity / 133.074m outstanding shares, not 163m listed shares.

SRDC.route_reason: Development and investment rights require asset-level appraisal; total book is only a tentative common-share screen.
SRDC.intrinsic_blocker: Parent attribution, property fair value, exceptional capital transactions and funding are not reconciled.
SRDC.source_warning: PSE parent-equity/income fields display zero despite positive total equity, so zero is treated as unavailable attribution. The PHP45.521m total-book proxy is not an appraisal and does not explain the much higher recent trading price.
